to.implementation_strategy: Create a new minimal Go module (e.g., cmd/pf-core/main.go + internal/ packages) as the native host for new shipped/sensitive features. Seam contract: define a narrow, versioned interface (subprocess JSON-lines over stdio or gRPC) between the Go host and the existing Python runtime; the Go side orchestrates and calls into Python only for legacy logic. Reuse semantics/naming from core/build_manager.py, core/build_utility.py, core/tier_builder.py so the build pipeline can compile both the Python side (Nuitka) and the Go binary (go build) into the same artifact bundle. Expose the Go entry through the packaging pipeline behind /api/v1/packaging/build (extend tier_builder to emit pf-core binary). go build must pass in CI; no Python->Go translation in this item (compile only, per title).

core/build_manager.py and core/tier_builder.py already own build orchestration; do not rebuild build orchestration in Go in this item.
to.rationale: This is the first executable slice of the settled 'Go core' architecture (BI-PF-0387/0388). assumptions: A Go toolchain can be added to CI and the packaging builder image.
Existing Python logic continues to run unchanged; the Go host is an orchestrator only in B1.
